objective: Evaluate exactly one bounded incremental-response candidate: begin native VLM/streaming-TTS work only for a stable, semantically complete incremental-ASR command, cancel and suppress it on any later preview/final identity revision, and require every replay-inclusive first-barge-to-new-audio measurement to be strictly below 800 ms without incorrect or speculative audible speech.

existing_incremental_asr_evidence.source: accepted Task 82 before-r1 raw wire capture; diagnostic observation only, not a new After measurement
existing_incremental_asr_evidence.implication_frozen_before_measurement: The complete Saturn command was not present in the sub-800 ms preview window. No eligibility relaxation is permitted after observing this or any later failure.

eligibility_rule.name: stable_complete_short_command_v1
eligibility_rule.scope: server-side realtime audio_output responses only; no client control
requirements: At least three completed consecutive incremental previews for the same segment have byte-identical trimmed UTF-8 text; streaming deltas alone are not eligibility evidence.
The complete candidate is 4..96 Unicode codepoints after trimming and contains no line break.
Chinese text must contain only CJK letters, ASCII letters/digits/spaces, and the explicit command punctuation set; no replacement character or unresolved bracket.
Every non-punctuation codepoint sequence is exactly one of the frozen semantic command grammars below. There is no fuzzy, prefix, confidence-score, or substring-only match.
The final normalized text must end in sentence-final Chinese or ASCII punctuation; a bare command prefix is not eligible.
A command containing negation, contrast, correction, condition, language-switch conflict, or an open coordination marker is rejected rather than interpreted.

If any later preview or final differs by even one byte after the same trim, immediately abort all uncommitted work and suppress its queued audio/text/ACK/terminal events; never commit the superseded response.
If eligibility is absent or uncertain, retain the unchanged ASR-final path and mark the incremental threshold NOT_MET.

grammars.name: saturn_topic_command
grammars.meaning: a complete request to stop the current narration and discuss Saturn's rings

grammars.name: english_switch_command
grammars.meaning: a complete request to switch the existing answer to English

eligibility_rule.why_not_low_confidence_partial: Eligibility needs three independently completed ASR results with exact cumulative identity, a fully matched terminal command grammar, and terminal punctuation. Low-confidence/streaming text, shorter prefixes, incomplete clauses, unseen commands and negated/revised forms cannot qualify. No transcript text is injected and the rule never rewrites the VLM input.

candidate.name: provisional_realtime_response_v1
behavior: On eligibility, submit the exact eligible preview text through the existing UnifiedEngine ASR-free VLM -> native streaming TTS path with the unchanged history, playback-ACK and sampling parameters.
Keep its provisional identity and segment binding explicit. Normal UnifiedEvent delivery remains the sole source of public text/audio; no transcript injection or synthetic model output exists.

On every subsequent completed preview and ASR final, compare exact trimmed text. A mismatch aborts the provisional UnifiedEngine request and drops all queued provisional public events before any further emission.

On an exact final match, retain the same response and history lifecycle rather than submitting a duplicate. On final mismatch, the unchanged final path starts a new response only after cancellation and suppression complete.
A newer utterance or ordinary barge-in cancels both ASR and provisional response ownership; stale ids cannot acknowledge or mutate the next response.
unchanged: public session fields and client controls
